steps.title: Open the master WI
steps.instruction: Open the master WI and confirm its revision matches the one shown on this work order.

steps.title: Check the part revision
steps.instruction: Confirm the part number and revision on the traveler match the drawing called out in the WI.

steps.title: Confirm effectivity
steps.instruction: Verify any engineering changes listed on the work order are incorporated before starting assembly.

operations.title: Record assembly completion
operations.description: Record the build-completion note for this operation.

steps.title: Prepare the work area
steps.instruction: Clean the bench, verify the ESD mat and wrist strap, and stage the kit.

steps.title: Assemble per WI
steps.instruction: Complete the assembly sequence shown in the WI figures. Log each calibrated tool you use.

steps.title: Torque and witness mark
steps.instruction: Torque fasteners to the values in the WI and apply witness marks.

steps.title: Record completion
steps.instruction: Write a completion note describing what was built and any observations.

operations.title: Record inspection result
operations.description: Document the inspection result against the acceptance criteria for this operation.

steps.title: Set up inspection
steps.instruction: Gather the inspection tools listed in the WI and confirm they are in calibration.

steps.title: Inspect features
steps.instruction: Measure each characteristic called out in the inspection table and compare it to tolerance.

steps.title: Record results
steps.instruction: Record measured values. Any out-of-tolerance result needs an NC before buy-off.

operations.title: Verify evidence package
operations.description: Check that every required work record is present before handoff.

steps.title: Collect records
steps.instruction: Confirm every prior operation has a stamp, date, and completion note.

steps.title: Check evidence
steps.instruction: Verify linked reports, photos, or recordings are attached and reviewed.

operations.title: Prepare QA handoff
operations.description: Prepare the completed record for quality review.

steps.title: Review the traveler
steps.instruction: Read through the full traveler for open items, holds, or missing entries.

steps.title: Hand off to QA
steps.instruction: Notify Quality that the work order is ready for final review.

reworkLibrary.title: Re-torque fastener(s) to drawing value
reworkLibrary.description: Re-torque fastener(s) to drawing value. Starter content: review against the part, the drawing and the NC before QA approval.

steps.title: Remove torque stripe
steps.instruction: Remove the existing torque stripe from the affected fastener(s) with an approved solvent.

steps.title: Loosen and clean
steps.instruction: Back off the fastener, inspect threads for damage, clean as required.

steps.title: Re-torque
steps.instruction: Torque to the drawing or WI value with a calibrated tool. Record the value and tool.

steps.title: Apply torque stripe
steps.instruction: Apply a new torque stripe across fastener and substrate.

reworkLibrary.title: Replace connector backshell and re-terminate
reworkLibrary.description: Replace connector backshell and re-terminate. Starter content: review against the part, the drawing and the NC before QA approval.

steps.title: De-mate and remove backshell
steps.instruction: De-mate the connector, remove the backshell and strain relief. Protect the pins.

steps.title: Inspect contacts
steps.instruction: Inspect contacts and wires for damage. Replace any damaged contact per the harness drawing.

steps.title: Install backshell
steps.instruction: Install the backshell and strain relief. Torque to the drawing value.

steps.title: Continuity check
steps.instruction: Perform a continuity check on affected circuits and record the result.
